ValidationRule.description: AttendeeType should not update on Chat/Store record types
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR(Interaction.Record_Type__c = 'Message', Interaction.Record_Type__c = 'In Person'), ISPICKVAL( AttendeeType ,'Customer') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update Attendee type to 'Customer' for Message/In Person record types
